label: Fates
tooltip: Settings for FATE automation and pot chest farming.

should_do_fates.label: Do FATEs
should_do_fates.tooltip: Allow the automator to select and run FATE goals.

prefer_pot_fates.label: Prefer pot FATEs
prefer_pot_fates.tooltip: Boost scoring for Persistent Pots and Pleading Pots when choosing a FATE.

min_pot_fate_minutes_remaining.label: Min pot FATE time remaining (minutes)
min_pot_fate_minutes_remaining.tooltip: Do not path to (or stay on) a pot FATE with fewer minutes left than this. Set to 0 to disable.

should_farm_pot_chests.label: Farm pot chests after pot FATEs
should_farm_pot_chests.tooltip: After completing a pot FATE, walk to linked chest positions and open them before choosing a new activity.

should_farm_reroll_pot_chests.label: Include reroll pot chests
should_farm_reroll_pot_chests.tooltip: Also farm the shared reroll chest positions after a pot FATE.

disabled_fate_ids.label: FATE availability
disabled_fate_ids.tooltip: Uncheck a FATE to exclude it from automator selection.
disabled_fate_ids.empty: No FATEs defined for the current zone.
